## Definition of done

- [ ] Tests at the right layers (unit / integration / component / E2E) pass
- [ ] Accessibility checked (axe clean; keyboard and screen-reader labels in both languages)
- [ ] Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR), light and dark themes checked
- [ ] Analytics events added or updated for new user actions
- [ ] Docs: ADR for significant decisions, runbook for anything operational, CHANGELOG entry
- [ ] API changes: `docs/api/openapi.json` regenerated in this PR; no breaking `/v1` change
- [ ] Unfinished work is behind a feature flag
- [ ] Migrations follow expand → deploy → contract
